FriendlyDifficult.Name: Friendly tokens = difficult terrain?
FriendlyDifficult.Hint: Decides whether a space occupied by a friendly token (same disposition) counts as difficult terrain when moving through it (double movement cost). Hostile tokens remain difficult terrain as usual. Only applies while dnd5e movement automation is enabled.
FriendlyDifficult.Difficult: Yes – friendly tokens are difficult terrain
FriendlyDifficult.Normal: No – moving through friendly tokens costs normal movement
FriendlyDifficult.System: System default (2014 rules: yes, 2024 rules: no)

Warnings.WrongSystem: Ascandir - DnD5e Movement Options only works with the D&D 5e game system.
